text: This was a few years ago while I was on B2 waiting for B1 but I had a business event I needed to attend in my home country. You can try applying for the reentry visa with a signed letter from your HR on company letterhead stating the exact dates you’ll be out of Israel for work and what you’ll be doing. You can Google business visa invitation letter for reference. They granted me a reentry visa for the exact dates I was going to be out of country per the letter so keep that in mind. But as Kathrin wrote, it’s really up to their discretion whether to give you one or not. Edit: the letter was in English and MH kept it.
